newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-IPE futures consolidate before more gains.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-IPE futures consolidate before more gains.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
* Some downside action may be seen today, mainly as a result of profit taking from this weeks gains, but as long as $18.60 is held on Brent then the bullish trend remains firmly intact.
* Gas oil's upside momentum continues to build with the market gapping bullishly higher on Thursday and after holding key 50 percent Fibonacci retracement last Monday.
IPE Brent crude and gas oil prices remain bullish longer term but analysts expect a period of consolidation on Friday before further resistance barriers are breached.
They said the usual bout of pre-weekend profit taking may knock prices back a little today but the market is well underpinned and they expected supports to hold.
Wee Woon Whai, analyst at MMS in Singapore said, "Overall I expect the market to continue to move higher, but we may see a short period of consolidation first".
Analysts allowed for some downside action today but as long as $18.60 is held then the bullish trend remains firmly intact.

Price action on the October Brent contract on Thursday left an inverted hammer formation on the chart where the market opens on or near its low then rallies, but the bulls failed to sustain the rally. Prices closed at or near the lows of the session.

This can be read as a potentially bullish signal according to Japanese Candlestick charting techniques, but the market must make, and hold, a gap higher in today's session to confirm this. If that holds it could spark a short-covering rally, though some analysts said this may not occur ahead of the weekend.

Supportively the market, on the spot month chart, closed just above the 10-day moving average line with some good clearance above the 20-day market, but RSI's are creeping back into the overbought region though at present are only just above neutral with the 14-day measure at around 58 percent.
Slow stochastics on the October chart are also pointing higher following Wednesday's bullish crossover.

The market is also holding well above parallel trendline support drawn from the low of last Friday at the same angle as the bullish trend from July 21 to August 7 this also continues to point the market higher.

To the upside trendline resistance comes in initially at around $19.27 then $19.64 the level where the previous rally broke down comes into view. Some analysts believe the market has sufficient momentum to get above this level

14-day RSI's stand in neutral territory and there is little sign of a bearish convergence on the 10 and 20 moving average lines. Slow stochastics lines on the September chart are on the point of crossing but at this lower level are likely to point the market higher again.
IPE Gas oil futures' upside momentum continues to build with the market gapping bullishly higher on Thursday after holding key 50 percent Fibonacci retracement last Monday.
"Onwards and upwards" said Tom James, analyst at Credit Lyonnais Rouse in Singapore. "Gas oil opened a key island formation to the upside when it gapped higher on Thursday".
--Colin Wooster, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
